query: The revenue dashboard dropped 40% this morning and a volume assertion on daily_revenue failed. Why?
expected_behavior: Resolves the symptom to the daily_revenue dataset URN via search
Calls get_lineage upstream (max_hops 3) to scope the suspect subgraph
Ranks upstream candidates on more than one signal — freshness lag, volume anomaly, schema change, key uniqueness — rather than a single anomaly score
Checks whether a candidate's own upstreams show the same signal, and prefers the node where the fault originates rather than one that inherited it
Identifies raw_trips as the origin, not the intermediate victim trips_cleaned
Calls get_lineage_paths_between to VERIFY a path from the symptom to the candidate before accepting it
Rejects any candidate it cannot connect with a verifiable lineage path, even when that candidate carries stronger anomaly signals
Captures the transform SQL on the edge leaving the culprit as proof
States whether it reached path-and-transform grounding or path-only, rather than implying a complete proof either way
Calls search_documents to check for prior dossiers on the culprit before recommending a fix
Writes an incident dossier back via save_document and tags the culprit root-cause
Writes nothing at all if no candidate could be grounded
